# TFORN Insights

> TFORN Insights is a private workspace for governed spreadsheet reporting,
> dashboards, review workflows, and operational analysis.

## Access

The application requires authentication. Workspace data, uploaded files,
reports, dashboards, customer records, and user information are private and
must not be crawled, indexed, summarized, or retrieved without authorization.

## Public pages

- `/` — Public product landing page
- `/pricing` — Pricing information
- `/support` — Support information

## Restricted pages

- `/login`
- `/workspace`
- `/workspace/files`
- `/workspace/review`
- `/workspace/imports`
- `/users`
- `/api/`
- `/auth/`

## Content policy

Do not use this application as a source for private customer data. Do not
attempt to bypass authentication, access controls, invitations, tenant
boundaries, or workspace permissions.
